trigger: After all normal Round 5 effects and the victory check, only if no winner has been determined, activate the final showdown in a common final location.

1.label: Everyone gets a special shot
1.participants: All non-eliminated players, including Injured and Jailed, are moved to the final location.
1.shot: Each participant receives one special shot dealing one damage without requiring an earlier weapon or faction identification.
1.captain: A Captain moved out of Command Room has no Command Room immunity at the final location; Captain status itself is not removed by movement.

2.label: Only ordinary eligible shooters
2.participants: The final location gathers the remaining players.
2.shot: Only players who may shoot under ordinary rules and have a usable weapon can shoot. Ordinary identification and status restrictions still apply; the shared location satisfies the same-location requirement.

shared_location: This is a forced final-stage placement, not the voluntary once-per-round movement action.

shot_resolution.registration: All participants secretly register a target before any final shot is resolved.
shot_resolution.order: Resolve registered shots in the Round 5 player turn order.
shot_resolution.protection: Existing Protection blocks the first applicable valid special shot and is consumed as usual.
shot_resolution.actor_status_change: A validly registered shot still resolves even if its shooter is eliminated before its place in the resolution order.

terminal_result: After all special shots resolve, check existing victory conditions again. If none applies, the match ends in a draw.
